release_launch_policy.fixture_credentials: Public controlled test credential; no paid or personal account used.

controlled_android_soak.memory_scope: App and instrumentation only; guest DSH/Node excluded
limitations: Controlled-provider instrumentation acceptance; does not establish battery, Doze or real-account behavior.

final_host_runner_smoke.memory_scope: App and instrumentation only; guest DSH/Node excluded
limitations: Controlled-provider instrumentation acceptance; does not establish battery, Doze or real-account behavior.

android_test_source_equivalence.scope: Entire Android app and instrumentation, shared core, runtimes, configuration and Android runtime preparation/checks. Later commits change only host acceptance tooling/tests/docs.

android_test_binary_equivalence.note: The debug app APK bytes are identical. Instrumentation APK archive bytes differ; all named ZIP entries have identical bytes, including test code, manifest and assets.

routine_editor.narrow_ui_check: 320 dp, 1.3 text scale, actual keyboard; native 240 dp high form regression

android.idle_connection_test: 20-minute controlled hold, measured Pixel-client keepalives, unchanged owner and confirmed delivery. Additional real DSH acceptance completes 12 chat/reopen turns with 45-second pauses, then DM/room checks.
android.drafts: Bounded in-memory conversation text; cleared only after acceptance. No process-death draft persistence.
android.unknown_delivery: Opaque per-account/session IDs persist before side effects; explicit user review unlocks, no automatic prompt replay.

limitations: Physical Android/16 KB execution, real-account model/image acceptance and battery/long-running background behavior remain open.
Text/photo drafts are not persisted across process death; only opaque pending-delivery metadata persists.
Full Hermes parity, server outbox/replay reconciliation, connector authorization, broad file attachments and native background completion notifications remain open.
Local DSH provider credentials remain in its owner-only file; the Android Keystore bridge remains follow-up work.

visual_checks.surface: Signed 2.2.3 demo home reached through the normal onboarding action
Signed direct upgrade retains the saved gateway and Dark appearance

next_android_cycle: Encrypted text drafts after process death, then native completion notifications, broader attachments and the DSH credential-vault bridge. Physical devices, battery/Doze and real accounts remain open.
